groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Roommates, flatmates and project teams — split a bill and see who owes whom.
groups.howItWorks: Add a bill and the group works out who owes whom. Settle up when the money changes hands.
groups.emptyBody: Start one for your hostel room, your flat, or your project team. Everyone can be added by name alone.
groups.needName: Please give the group a name.
groups.created: "{name}" is ready — add the first bill.
groups.currencyHelp: Every bill in this group is in this currency. Leave it as yours unless the group agrees otherwise.
groups.noPeopleYet: No one added yet. You are the first member.
groups.mateEmailHint: With an email we can link their account the moment they register.
groups.needMate: Give the roommate a name or an email address.
groups.splitEqualHelp: Everyone pays the same share. If the bill does not divide exactly, the odd cent goes to the first member.
groups.splitSharesHelp: 1 is a normal share, 2 is double. An empty box counts as 1.
groups.splitExactHelp: Type what each person pays. The amounts must add up to the bill.
groups.noCategories: No categories yet — the bill can be saved without one.
groups.needBillTitle: Please give the bill a short name.
groups.needExact: Enter an amount for every person.
groups.needOneMate: Add at least one roommate before splitting a bill.
groups.billAdded: Bill added — the balances are up to date.
groups.noBills: No bills yet. Add the first one above.
groups.balancesHelp: What each person has paid, minus their share, minus what has been settled.
groups.settleAmountHelp: In {currency}. It cannot be more than what is still owed.
groups.needPair: Choose who is paying and who is receiving.
groups.settledToast: Settled — the board is up to date.
groups.archiveBody: "{name}" leaves the list but keeps every bill and balance.
groups.archivedNote: This group is closed — the numbers are still here, it is just out of your list.
groups.deleteBody: "{name}" and all of its bills and settlements are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
